source_prompt.title: Source Prompt
source_prompt.description: The product-reference-storyboard prompt to shorten. This is the source of truth; optimize it without inventing new shots, product facts, characters, claims, prices, ratings, badges, or visible text.

target_max_chars.title: Hard Character Limit
target_max_chars.description: Hard maximum character count for the returned prompt. Default is 3800 for image-provider compatibility.

preferred_target_chars.title: Preferred Character Target
preferred_target_chars.description: Preferred shorter target that leaves room for downstream system variance. Default is 3600.

preserve_storyboard_contract.title: Preserve Storyboard Contract
preserve_storyboard_contract.description: When true, preserve all detected frames, frame order, visual-only frame prose, shared CAMERA/LIGHT/DEPTH, shared PRODUCT VERIFY, and required product/text/realism locks. Do not keep STORY MATCH, HUMAN REALISM, or VISUAL labels inside frame text.

optimization_strength.title: Optimization Strength
optimization_strength.description: How aggressively to shorten the prompt. Auto starts moderate and becomes aggressive only if the prompt remains over the target.
